name: LEGO Monkie Kid
description: Centuries ago, the beloved Chinese Monkey King used his magical staff to capture and trap the evil Demon Bull King deep inside a mountain. Flash-forward to modern-day China, when fate leads MK (aka Monkie Kid), a young noodle shop delivery boy, to find the long-lost staff. Soon, MK and his best friends find themselves entangled in adventures packed full of action, mystery, imagination and magic.

videos.title: Monkie Kid: A Hero is Born (Pilot)
videos.overview: A young boy named “MK”, who is obsessed with the old legends, discovers Monkey King’s staff that was left on top of a hill to imprison the Demon Bull King. After Demon Bull King is released, MK must go on a journey of self-discovery to become the hero this generation needs. Through trial and tribulation, MK will discover new powers, responsibilities and ways of defeating the villains in this futuristic world.

videos.title: Revenge of the Spider Queen
videos.overview: The ancient and evil Spider Queen emerges from her lair. With the help of a "shadowy" figure, the Spider Queen is supercharged, using her power to capture Monkey King and Demon Bull King. It's up to MK and his team to track down ingredients for an antidote to cure the citizens and free the city.

videos.title: Bad Weather
videos.overview: After the humiliating defeat of DBK, Red Son decides to reclaim some villainous glory by taking over the "Weather Station" a prestigious club that allows its members to control the weather in different parts of the city. MK, overconfident with his new powers, attempts to defeat Red Son, but his lack of control and discipline causes some trouble.

videos.title: Duplicatnation
videos.overview: After Mr. Tang mentions the famed power of the Monkey King to duplicate himself, MK decides to do the same and creates "corrupted" clones, that supposedly will do everything for everyone while he stays home and plays video games. But, since MK is undisciplined, and doesn't really know how to use his powers, the clones go crazy, wreaking havoc.

videos.title: Coming Home
videos.overview: When Mei, a member of the fabled and prestigious Dragon Family, is asked to house sit, MK begs to come along. General Ironclad, one of the DBK's minions, hears that the Dragon Family will be gone and realizes there's an opening to infiltrate the Dragon Temple House and steal the legendary Dragon Blade. But Mei defends her home and claims her birthright as the wielder of the fabled sword.

videos.title: Noodles or Death
videos.overview: Pigsy and Mr. Tang, on the hunt for ingredients for the perfect meal, are taken hostage by the villainous Spider Queen. Sandy, MK, Mei, and Mo must take their new boat down into the sewers and free their friends before they become the main ingredients in Spider Queen's dinner.

videos.title: Calabash
videos.overview: MK wakes up to a perfect life... TOO perfect. Evidently, he's defeated the entire DBK family and everyone treats him like a hero. MK soon realizes everything is not as it seems, but that he's living in an illusion brought on by being trapped in the nefarious Calabash, an ancient magical device wielded by two mischievous demons. MK must shake off the illusion to defeat his comically weird enemies.

videos.title: The Great Wall Race
videos.overview: Everyone in the city is abuzz with the talk of an upcoming street race that will grant the winner "immortality". Mei and MK enter the race but a disagreement has them competing against each other. Their frustration boils over, causing them both to wreck and the DBK family to take the lead. Our heroes must learn to work together to defeat the DBK clan before they can claim the ultimate prize!

videos.title: Impossible Delivery
videos.overview: MK is easily distracted, something that hasn't gone unnoticed by his employer, Pigsy, who challenges MK to deliver an order in an allotted time. MK must go through a series of obstacles that challenges his focus in order to accomplish his goal. Eventually, he succeeds and arrives at his destination, delivering the order to... The Monkey King!

videos.title: Skeleton Key
videos.overview: DBK's family's found a mysterious power source that will allow the brute to reclaim his former glory. But the strange item is locked behind an impervious ancient gate that needs a key... the same key that was given to MK as a 'thank you' for saving the city over and over. Now, it's a game of cat and mouse as DBK's family tries to get the key and our heroes attempt to keep it out of their hands.

videos.title: Macaque
videos.overview: The mysterious and powerful Macaque shows up in the city, helping MK thwart an evil cloud of smoke. He offers to train MK. But the new teacher is actually an old enemy of the Monkey King and is trying to siphon the Monkey King's powers from MK to defeat his fabled arch nemesis. It's up to MK to rise up and help the Monkey King before all his power is gone.

videos.title: The End is Here!
videos.overview: When MK arrives back in the city after an extended training session with Monkey King, he discovers the villainous Demon Bull King has taken over the city! Now he must use everything he’s learned this season to break into DBK’s hideout and defeat the family that causes him so much trouble!

videos.title: Sleep Bug
videos.overview: A new game sweeps across the city, but instead of fun and frivolity, the game is actually a virus that knocks out everyone who plays it, leaving the "Cloud" free and clear to be pilfered by one of Spider Queen's minions - Syntax, the Tech Spider! It's up to MK to swing into action, shut down the cloud, and wake up the city.

videos.title: Dumpling Destruction
videos.overview: MK receives a mysterious call from Monkey King. Turns out, he may have accidentally knocked over a "Celestial Dumpling". It's streaking toward earth, and if it hits... well, everything will be destroyed. To contain the Dumpling, MK and Tang must find a Mystical Vase at Flower Fruit Mountain, a place replete with mystery and danger.

videos.title: Pig Pong Panic
videos.overview: Pigsy has replaced the Monkey Mech game with Ping Pong and gets wildly addicted. MK has to break Pigsy from his addiction in order to save his shop. Meanwhile - Sandy accidentally gets put to sleep with a supercharged sleepy time tea. When a box, marked "from Monkey King" arrives, Mo finds himself having to take care of a bunch of Fruit Babies that are running rampant all throughout the boat.

videos.title: Sweet'n'Sour
videos.overview: Speedy Panda stores have appeared everywhere along with their biker gang delivery boys. Things boil over until a "food war" is declared. "Food critics" arrive, and Pigsy and friends must compete in a Food Olympics against Speedy Panda... which just so happens to be owned by Jin and Yin, the Gold and Silver Demons!

videos.title: Minor Scale
videos.overview: MK accidentally shrinks himself and falls down the drain, into the sewers, and finds himself back in the lair of the Spider Queen. Trying to escape, MK finds a young girl in need of rescuing. However, she's really Lady Bone Demon in disguise! Meanwhile, Tang has become a food critic, and Pigsy bends over backwards to make sure he's pleased.

videos.title: Game On
videos.overview: MK is stuck in his training. He's not really advancing in his power set and feels like he'll never really be the hero he needs to be unless he goes through exactly what Monkey King went through. When he finds a VR video game that emulates the Monkey King's battles, MK jumps in, hoping to "live" Monkey King's life in order to be a better hero.

videos.title: Shadow Play
videos.overview: Our heroes attend a shadow play, secretly run by the Macaque. Using a magical lantern, he imprisons the other heroes to toy with MK. MK feels a strong connection to the play, about a Warrior abandoned by his Hero. When Macaque finally reveals himself, he torments MK for not realising his friends were missing. Macaque declares he will be MK's teacher, even if MK doesn't want him to be.

videos.title: To Catch a Leaf
videos.overview: MK has got a bad case of the hiccups. Real bad. Because of his powers, every time he hiccups it causes a giant earthquake! There's only one thing that can cure it, a special tea made from a flower that only Sandy can procure from a dangerous location. While he attempts to find the leaf, Huntsman; one of Spider Queen's henchmen, is in pursuit, trying to steal the flower for his master.

videos.title: 72 Transformations
videos.overview: MK has learned the power of TRANSFORMATION! Kind of... When Spider-Bots steal Pigsy's sign, MK needs to use his new powers to get it back! Down in Spider Queen's lair, MK finds she is trying to build a weapon to fight her old ally, Lady Bone Demon. He knows he needs to stop her, but maybe there's hope for his old enemy?

videos.title: This Is the End!
videos.overview: After gathering all the secret ingredients, Lady Bone Demon creates a POWERFUL BONE MECH which she uses to attack MK while he is out training. Even though MK has gained new powers, Lady Bone Demon has figured out how to defend against each one and everything turns sideways as MK is defeated! Now our hero desperately needs help to make it out alive, and find some way to come back and save the day!

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: Monkey King battles the hero Ne Zha for a map that will lead to a weapon strong enough to defeat the Lady Bone Demon. With MK in peril, Monkey King uses the last of his strength to get back, but not before MK loses his powers. Now, MK, Monkey King, and the other heroes are on the run, pursued by the Macaque! Without his powers, MK must make a tough choice in order to defeat the villain!

videos.title: Great Grand Dragon of the East
videos.overview: When the heroes' drone crashes in the ocean, they are captured by the Dragon of the East, Mei's distant uncle! Furious with Monkey King for stealing the staff eons ago, he confiscates the map and imprisons the heroes... all except Mei! Now it's up to her to retake the map and save her friends before Macaque catches up to them!

videos.title: Smartie Kid
videos.overview: The heroes drive across a vast desert, headed for the first location on the map. When their van breaks down, the team is stranded until they find an Oasis owned by the crafty Goldfish Demon! He offers to let them try and win whatever they need in his game show. MK, desperate to prove he can be the 'smart one' now he has no powers, agrees to play. Problem is, he's not the smart one!

videos.title: The Winning Side
videos.overview: After a pitstop, the heroes get back on the road. Strangely, MK notices they're headed East, not West! Something's wrong! We soon learn Macaque has tricked them and is bringing MK back to Lady Bone Demon. Meanwhile, Pigsy, Mr Tang, and Monkey King realise they've been separated from the others, but before they can go looking for them, they are attacked by a horrifying demon!

videos.title: Amnesia Rules
videos.overview: When a demon attacks, Tang and Pigsy know their only choice is to wake Monkey King from his mystic meditation. Monkey King scares off the demon, but now thinks he's his younger self! When the demon kidnaps Tang, it's up to Pigsy and Young Monkey King to rescue their friend. Meanwhile, Tang wakes up in the castle of a beautiful Queen who 'rescued him from the demon'. Tang isn't buying it...

videos.title: The First Ring
videos.overview: MK, Mei and Sandy find themselves stranded in the desert, but a familiar figure emerges to save them: Red Son is back! Bringing the trio to his family's fortress, the heroes overstay their welcome with the villainous trio as they try to find out everything they can about the creation of the Samadhi Fire... and soon realize that the first ring is here, in Demon Bull King's nose!

videos.title: Cooking with Chang'e
videos.overview: Watching Pigsy's favourite cooking show, "Cooking with Chang'e", MK realises the second ring of Samadhi is there in her kitchen... On the moon! Soon, Pigsy, MK and the Monkey King are flying to the moon in a rocket! Making their way through Chang'e's solar base, they need to avoid Chang'e's killer bunny mechs and make it to the kitchen! However, getting out is going to be even harder than getting in!

videos.title: Benched
videos.overview: The heroes arrive at the last stop on the map: Lantern City! But to get the final ring, they'll need to compete in a talent show! Stuck as band manager, Tang doesn't want to just sit around and wait. He's going to find the ring himself! Unfortunately, he's leading the Macaque right to it! To everyone's surprise, Tang stands up to Macaque, tapping into a power he didn't know existed...

videos.title: The King, the Prince, and the Shadow
videos.overview: Now with all three rings, the heroes ask Monkey King 'what's next?' But before he can answer, Ne Zha arrives, hunting them down. While Monkey King holds Ne Zha off, MK and the heroes must get the rings to a mystic mountain where they can reforge the fire. However, when Macaque arrives, now supercharged with Bone Demon power, things go from bad to worse.

videos.title: The Samadhi Fire
videos.overview: Now that the ritual has been started, it can't be stopped. Worse, something is happening to Mei! Ancient secrets are revealed as Monkey King finally tells the heroes the truth: there is a fourth ring! All of the Samadhi Fire is absorbed into Mei, and there are now two unstoppable forces for the heroes to contend with. The Monkie Kid team is pushed to breaking point, and nothing will be the same!

videos.title: Embrace Your Destiny: This Imperfect World
videos.overview: With the heroes' team in disarray, MK and Ne Zha try desperately to stop the Monkey King from confronting the Lady Bone Demon on his own, while Mei learns how to control the Samadhi Fire with Red Son. When MK catches up to the Monkey King, it seems that his mentor might actually stand a chance of defeating her!

videos.title: Embrace Your Destiny: The Corrupted King
videos.overview: The Lady Bone Demon successfully overcomes the Monkey King and now has the perfect champion to complete her 'destiny'. MK reunites with Mei and Red Son, but before they can come up with a plan, the corrupted Monkey King arrives to take Mei and the Samadhi Fire to his new master! Now MK and the heroes will need to fight their strongest opponent ever!

videos.title: Embrace Your Destiny: Time to Be Warriors
videos.overview: With the Monkey King under Lady Bone Demon's control and Mei imprisoned in her tower, MK and other heroes formulate a plan to rescue their friends and save the world. With help from Macaque, new information from a depowered Mayor, and the Lady Bone Demon's power stretch thin, this is their last chance to stop Lady Bone Demon!

videos.title: Embrace Your Destiny: Destiny Fulfilled
videos.overview: The final battle between the heroes and Lady Bone Demon has begun. MK must save his mentor from her control and stop her before she can release the Samadhi Fire and destroy the world! When all our heroes embrace their own destinies, the ultimate fight is on. Working together, they have one shot at defeating their ultimate enemy once and for all!

videos.title: Familiar Tales
videos.overview: MK is living that hero lifestyle, busting bad guys and saving the day, until he opens a cursed scroll and his world is flipped upside down once again!

videos.title: New Adventures
videos.overview: Unable to reseal the scroll, MK's friends become trapped inside! Luckily, a mysterious new hero arrives in time to save Mei and MK from the same fate!

videos.title: The Great Tang Man
videos.overview: In order to find Tang, our heroes must start their Journey where Monkey King began his! In the company of the great monk Tang Sanzang.

videos.title: Pig-Napped!
videos.overview: Kidnapped by Pigsy in the body of his demonic ancestor, Zhu Ganglie, Tang must help Pigsy remember who he is before he's turned into demon-dinner!

videos.title: Court of the Yellow Robed Demon
videos.overview: When our heroes are scattered to different memories, Mei is captured by a powerful demon, and her family sword is broken!

videos.title: Show Me the Monster
videos.overview: Trapped in the body of his ancestor, Sandy challenges Pigsy to a fight! Meanwhile, MK meets the wise master who taught Monkey King all he knows.

videos.title: Pitiful Creatures
videos.overview: As MK faces off with the scroll's curse, he's forced to confront his mysterious past and his ominous future.

videos.title: The Brotherhood
videos.overview: Pulled from the scroll, the gang find themselves facing a new threat. This time, they are totally outclassed.

videos.title: Roast of the Monkie Kids
videos.overview: As the Brotherhood prepare their assault on the Celestial Realm, the heroes must train if they have any chance of saving the world!

videos.title: The Jade Emperor
videos.overview: Things aren't looking good as the Brotherhood overwhelms the Celestial Armies. Desperate to act, Mei leads the charge in a rescue mission.

videos.title: The Emperor's Wrath: A Lifetime of Mistakes
videos.overview: With the fate of the universe in the balance, the team's only hope lies in someone who stood up to the Jade Emperor before and survived: Monkey King.

videos.title: The Emperor's Wrath: The Plan Man
videos.overview: The gang gear up and prepare for their own assault on the Celestial Realm.

videos.title: The Emperor's Wrath: Rip and Tear
videos.overview: The universe tears at the seams as MK and friends engage in a final standoff with The Brotherhood.

videos.title: The Emperor's Wrath: Better Than We Found It
videos.overview: It's all over! The New Jade Emperor's power is completely out of control and the universe tearing apart before our heroes' eyes! MK must help his enemy become the hero he believes himself to be before it's too late!

videos.title: Strings That Bind
videos.overview: MK is tormented by visions of the past and future. Monkey King and Macaque brace for the impending storm, facing the unknown.

videos.title: Collar the King
videos.overview: MK, Monkey King and Macaque are called to the Underworld to stand trial for their 'crimes,' confronting their past misdeeds.

videos.title: Temple of the Goddess
videos.overview: On the run from the celestial realm, our heroes seek the five Color Stones to save the universe! Their first destination: Burning Mountain!

videos.title: The Storm Within
videos.overview: Sandy demands a one-on-one training session with MK. To his dismay, Sandy's technique is not combat, but meditation.

videos.title: Claim to Flame
videos.overview: The team splits up to locate the next stone. Pigsy and Tang encounter trouble, while Mei runs into a familiar face from her past.

videos.title: Festival Fugitives
videos.overview: At a food festival, the heroes search for the next stone, but they instead find Ne Zha and the celestial host blocking their path.

videos.title: Into the Pagoda
videos.overview: Inside Li Jing's Pagoda, a demon traps the heroes in memories. MK is shown memories he never knew existed.

videos.title: The Cage
videos.overview: Now that the heroes obtained all of the Color Stones, it's time to save the world! However, the secret enemy reveals himself, signaling that their trials are only beginning.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: As the enemy fights the heroes, MK must confront his mentor. He knows what he must do, but Monkey King is trying to prevent him from following through with his destiny.

videos.title: Harbinger
videos.overview: Amid the chaos beyond the world, MK encounters the goddess Nüwa and uncovers a secret so devastating it could alter everything.

language: Min Nan, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese, Chinese, English
